title: ever NOAH|Chiffon A-Line Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This dress features a flattering V-neckline and a softly draped waist that creates a smooth, feminine silhouette. The lightweight fabric moves with ease, while the subtle slit adds a touch of flow without feeling overdone. Short sheer sleeves offer light coverage, making it a versatile choice for bridesmaids, wedding guests, and formal occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
